name: From beliefs to evidence
summary: Start with what you believe, test the riskiest belief, and rebuild the models on what people did.

steps.label: Write down beliefs and build proto models
steps.note: Personas, journeys and jobs, each marked as an assumption, and the belief to test first.

steps.label: Plan the study
steps.note: Or a survey, usability test or diary study, picked by what the belief is about.

steps.label: Take in each study
steps.note: Shows which beliefs it bears on, without rewriting anything.

steps.label: Sort, summarise and rebuild
steps.note: Affinity diagram, summary, then the models rebuilt in real mode with every line linked to its source.

name: From objects to a clickable prototype
summary: Eight Design OS stages, each a file the next one reads. A script fails when the chain breaks.

steps.label: Interaction flows
steps.note: Including what happens when it goes wrong.

steps.label: Screen inventory
steps.note: Every screen in the flow, with five states each.

steps.label: Lo-fi prototype
steps.note: Every arrow in the flow has to be clickable.

name: Building a design system
summary: ds-kit's build chain. Each stage writes a file the next reads, and records whether each value was measured, chosen, derived or assumed.

steps.label: Direction
steps.note: Or the direction create-design-system writes from the evidence.

steps.label: Can an AI agent build with it?

name: Iterating a page to a bar
summary: The Design Agent designs, an independent critic scores, and the loop runs until the page meets the bar or a person decides.

steps.label: Score the pass with fresh eyes
Fix, re-render, re-score
steps.note: Repeats until the exit bar is met.

name: From an idea to a built feature
summary: Plan with questions, approve the plan, then build slice by slice with a reviewer on every pass.

steps.label: Plan: look things up, ask one question at a time
Review every pass
steps.note: A gate holds the build until lint, tests and the design system pass.

name: Critique against your own rules
summary: Capture the page, agree what it is for, then critique it only against rules the project wrote down.

steps.label: Capture and ask what the page is for
Critique, verify, revise
steps.note: Every issue quotes a rule from taste.md or DESIGN.md.

name: Running someone else's skill honestly
summary: Use a third-party skill as it is, but file what it says so a belief never looks like a finding.

steps.label: Run it unedited and file the output
steps.note: Every claim goes in a table, tagged as belief or evidence.

steps.label: Audit the claims
steps.note: Is the table complete, and does each citation support its claim?
